subject.title: fix(opencode-go): enable xhigh/max thinking levels for DeepSeek V4

question: Should maintainers adopt https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99643 as the canonical OpenCode Go DeepSeek V4 fix and ask this PR to rebase to that design, or retain this branch for a narrowed repair?
rationale: Both branches target the same user-visible gap, but this branch changes the existing `high` mapping and duplicates shared behavior, while the alternative claims a broader provider-policy solution. Selecting the canonical implementation and resolving the linked same-author issue/PR pairing requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt the provider-profile fix
options.body: Confirm the current viability of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99643, then use its provider-policy and shared-wrapper-preserving design as the canonical path.

options.title: Repair this branch narrowly

options.title: Pause both candidates
